CAPSTONE_SIGNATURES.Coral Reef: Biodiversity: +1 multiplier for each different station on your mat.
CAPSTONE_SIGNATURES.Robot: Upgrade: every card on your mat scores +5.
CAPSTONE_SIGNATURES.Homestead: Home-Grown: cards with their whole recipe on your mat score ×3 instead of ×2.
CAPSTONE_SIGNATURES.Maglev Train: Freight: tier 1 cards stack 3 to a slot and score +2 each.
CAPSTONE_SIGNATURES.Ecosystem: Old Growth: +1 multiplier for each board check in a row it's been on your mat.
CAPSTONE_SIGNATURES.Fruit Cake: Four-Layer Cake: all 4 suits on your mat doubles your Quarks.
CAPSTONE_SIGNATURES.Metropolis: Expansion: your mat has 2 extra slots.
CAPSTONE_SIGNATURES.Space Station: Orbit: cards from the station you're travelling to score ×2.

The Ocean.title: Pop the Bubbles
The Ocean.blurb: Tap rising bubbles before they float off the top.

The Power Plant.title: Untangle the Wires
The Power Plant.blurb: Drag each handle so no wire crosses another.

Greenhouse.title: Catch the Eggs
Greenhouse.blurb: Drag the basket under falling eggs. Dodge the bad ones.

Deep Mine.title: Break the Rocks
Deep Mine.blurb: Tap a rock again and again to crack it open.

Old Growth Forest.title: Plant the Trees
Old Growth Forest.blurb: Tap when the arm sweeps through the green zone.

The Bakery.title: Fill the Order
The Bakery.blurb: Match the base, icing, and topping shown, then send it.

The City.title: Stack the Stones
The City.blurb: Tap to drop each stone lined up with the one below.

The Observatory.title: Fly the Rocket
The Observatory.blurb: Hold left or right to steer and dodge the asteroids.
